claire.greet: Hello {name}! What do you need today?
claire.greet_sub: Tap an option, or hold the mic and just tell me — e.g. "1000 cotton track pants under 170, Kolkata, in 2 weeks".
claire.ask_style: Here are {cat} on CLAIRE. Tap ♥ on styles you like, then Done.
claire.ask_qty_hint: Packed in size sets ({set}). I will round to whole sets.
claire.ask_time: When do you need it in {city}?
claire.results_none: No seller has this at your budget yet.
claire.results_note_combo: No single seller has {qty} ready — I combined sellers with the same fabric.
claire.not_understood: Sorry, I didn’t catch that. Tap one of these:
claire.handoff: Let me connect you to our Trade Desk. Someone who speaks your language will join shortly.
claire.sell_prompt: Send me photos of your products (up to 12). I will turn them into a catalog. Tap 📷 below.
claire.orders_none: No orders yet. Want to find something?
claire.job_title: Need stitching, printing or dyeing? Tell me the garment, quantity, days and rate.
claire.job_split_title: No single unit can finish {qty} in {days} days. Best split:
claire.onb_q_intro: Hello! I am Claire. What is your name, and what is your business called?
claire.onb_q_business: What does your business do? What do you make or sell, and what do you buy?
claire.onb_q_location: Where is your unit or shop? Tell me the town and area.
claire.onb_q_gst: Do you have a GST number? Say it, or tap Skip.
claire.onb_done: Thank you, {name}! Here is your profile. Is it correct?
claire.catalog_live: Your catalog is live: {n} products. Share your shop: {url}

deals.lead_market: Market median for this spec is {median}; your listed price is {mine}.
deals.lead_market_only: Market median for this spec is {median}.
deals.combo: Combo order: your share is {qty} {unit}{budget}. Other sellers in this order cannot see your price.
deals.job: Job-work offer from {buyer}: {qty} pcs at {price}/pc, needed in {days} days. Accept, counter or decline.
deals.offer_market: Market median for this spec is {median}. {seller}: trust {trust}{ontime}.
deals.offer_hint: Send this as an offer at {price}?
deals.offer_hint_ctx: Listed at {listed}/pc. Sellers usually settle 3–6% lower, around {lo}–{hi}. Send {price} as your offer?
deals.advance_paid: Order {code}: {buyer} marked the advance of {amount} as paid.
deals.delivered_closed: Order {code} delivered. It was fully paid in advance, so the order is complete. Thank you!
deals.balance_paid: Order {code}: balance {amount} paid. Order closed — thank you!
deals.problem: Order {code}: a problem was reported. Trade Desk ticket {ticket} is open; a person will join this chat.
deals.desk_called: I have asked our Trade Desk to help here. A person will join this chat soon ({ticket}).
deals.auto_copy: Claire replied to the buyer for you: "{reply}"
deals.auto_fallback: Namaste! {title}: {price} per {unit}, minimum {moq}{stock}. Please share quantity, sizes and delivery date.
deals.rated_both: Both sides have rated order {code}. Ratings are now visible on profiles.
deals.concierge: Large order {code}: our Trade Desk will help both sides with samples and payment terms.

desk.assigned: Trade Desk ticket {code}: {agent} (speaks {langs}) will join you shortly.
desk.queued: Trade Desk ticket {code} is open. A person will reply within {min} min.
desk.next_quality_dispute: Ask the buyer for photos and the count of faulty pieces, then call the seller with the LR / packing details and agree on replacement, partial refund or recount.
desk.next_short_delivery: Ask the buyer how many pieces and bundles arrived against the invoice, check the seller's packing list and LR weight, then agree on sending the missing pieces, a partial refund or a recount.
desk.next_late_delivery: Check the promised dispatch days against the order dates, call the seller for a firm dispatch / delivery date and the LR, and update the buyer.
desk.next_payment_due: Call the buyer about the pending balance of {amount} (due {date}); agree a payment date and record it on the order.
desk.next_payment_amount: Call the buyer about the pending balance of {amount}; agree a payment date and record it on the order.
desk.next_payment_followup: Call the buyer about the pending payment and agree a payment date.
desk.next_dispute: Read the chat, call both sides and calm things down; check payment and dispatch records before taking a side.
desk.next_help: Call the user in their language and finish what they were trying to do.
desk.next_concierge: Call the buyer to confirm specs, a sample and payment terms for this large order; introduce a backup seller.
desk.next_onboarding_assist: Call and help them finish their profile and first listings.
desk.next_verification_visit: Schedule a unit visit, record photos and mark the unit visited.
desk.next_seller_nudge: Call the seller and ask them to reply to the waiting enquiry (or switch on Claire auto-reply).

reasons.balance: Best balance of price, trust and speed.
reasons.split: Split across {n} suppliers to cover the full quantity.
